name: filter_regex
description: A regex match per document. Needs script.painless.regex.enabled to be limited or true - it is limited by default, which caps complexity rather than forbidding regexes.

script.source: def v = doc['identified_content_language']; if (v.size() == 0) return true; return (v.value =~ /^[a-z]{2,3}$/) || true;
